analysis_metadata.description: Independent scikit-learn validation of weather engine backtest results

calibration_comparison.description: Compare hand-rolled calibration (0pp) vs sklearn IsotonicRegression and Platt scaling

summary.note: Positive delta = improvement over raw confidence.

calibration_comparison.limitations: Calibration comparison uses synthetic trade-level data generated by adding uniform noise (eps=0.045) within each confidence bucket to spread aggregated confidence values. This artificial dispersion inflates the Brier/ECE of raw confidence, making sklearn calibration methods appear more beneficial than they actually are. The real raw calibration from the sweep: Brier=0.2278, ECE=0.1727 for the best config.

nwp_feature_importance.description: GradientBoosting and RandomForest on NWP features to predict model agreement

regime_clustering.description: KMeans and GaussianMixture on station-month climate features

regime_analysis.interpretation: Regimes defined by temperature and variability. Compares to current broken regime classifier.

regime_clustering.data_quality_note: Station climatology data has quality issues: std_high is 0.0 for all stations, and July mean_high for KATL is 338.56°F (likely corrupted). This affects clustering quality. The regime taxonomy should be re-run after data quality fixes.

statistical_validation.description: Independent sklearn.metrics validation of top configs

sweep_reported_metrics.config: best_by_accuracy (conf=0.796, agree=4, train=318d, test=31d, off=16.0F, decay=0.802, win=17d)
best_by_sharpe (conf=0.788, agree=4, train=318d, test=33d, off=13.2F, decay=0.624, win=75d)
best_all_rounder (conf=0.795, agree=4, train=109d, test=51d, off=3.7F, decay=0.875, win=20d)

statistical_validation.limitations: Sklearn per-config metrics (Kappa, MCC) are computed from synthetic trade-level data generated by random shuffling of aggregated bucket counts. This does NOT preserve the actual prediction-outcome correlation structure. The correct MCC values are reported in sweep_reported_metrics above (MCC=0.46 for best config). Per-trade data from the actual backtest engine would be needed for proper sklearn metrics.
